props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the whole process — “Deploying to production”.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the process started. The elapsed timer counts from here while a step is active.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with a step id when its retry is pressed. Without it, no retry is offered.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled: whether the step list is shown.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the step list starts shown, when uncontrolled.
